list.title: Users
list.subtitle: Manage user accounts in your organization.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or ID...

table.noResults: No users found matching your search.

createDialog.title: Create New User
createDialog.description: Add a new user to your organization. You can optionally assign a role during creation.
createDialog.stationsLoadFailed: Could not load the stations list.
createDialog.stationsEmpty: No stations are available. Contact your administrator.
createDialog.stationsHint: Select the stations this user may work with. If you select none, the user gets company-wide access to ALL stations.
createDialog.stationsNoneWarning: No station selected: the new user will have company-wide access to every station.
createDialog.allStationsHint: A Warehouse Manager serves every station, so no station selection is needed. The account is company-wide and automatically covers stations added later.
createDialog.limitedCreatorHint: You can only give this role the stations you manage. Choose at least one.

editDialog.title: Edit User
editDialog.description: Update user information. Only changed fields will be sent.
editDialog.stationsLoadFailed: Could not load the stations list.
editDialog.stationsEmpty: No stations are available. Contact your administrator.
editDialog.stationsHint: Select the stations this user may work with. If you select none, the user gets company-wide access to ALL stations.
editDialog.stationsClearWarning: No station selected: saving will give this user company-wide access to every station.
editDialog.stationsUnconfirmed: Station assignments could not be confirmed
editDialog.clearManagerTitle: This will also remove the station manager
editDialog.clearManagerBody: This user is the designated manager of: {{stations}}. Removing their access to these stations also clears the station's manager. Nobody else is changed.
editDialog.managerCleared: Saved. The designated manager was cleared on: {{stations}}. Choose a new manager from the station page.

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate User
deactivateDialog.description: Are you sure you want to deactivate "{{name}}"? They will no longer be able to sign in. This can be reversed by an admin (Edit user → set Active).

deleteDialog.title: Delete User
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete the user "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

deleteAccountDialog.title: Delete my account
deleteAccountDialog.description: This will deactivate your account. You will not be able to sign in again. Enter your current password to confirm.

errors.notAllowed: Your role is not allowed to delete its own account. Ask your company administrator.
errors.lastAdmin: You are the last active administrator of this company. Assign another administrator first.
errors.protectedAccount: This account cannot be deleted from here.
errors.server: The server could not process the request. Try again later.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.

updateUser.title: Update User
updateUser.subtitle: Modify user details and permissions.
updateUser.notFoundDescription: The user with ID "{{id}}" could not be found.

capabilities.title: Individual permissions
capabilities.description: Allow or deny specific actions for this person only. Their Job Title, and everyone else with it, stay unchanged. You can only allow what the platform administrator has made available for this person's Job Title.
capabilities.loadFailed: Could not load this person's permissions.

readonly.self: You can't change your own permissions.
readonly.protected: This person is a company administrator. Their permissions can't be changed here.

roleSource.no: The role does not grant it

restricted.role: The platform administrator has not allowed this person's Job Title to hold this permission, so it cannot be allowed here.
restricted.noJobTitle: This person has no Job Title, so nothing can be allowed for them. Ask the platform administrator to assign one.
restricted.notGrantable: Not available: the platform administrator has not made this permission available to allow per person.
restricted.notWhitelisted: Not available for this kind of company.
restricted.unverifiable: The platform's permission setting cannot be checked right now, so allowing it is unavailable. Try again shortly.

errors.selfChange: You can't change your own permissions.
errors.protectedUser: This person is a protected administrator; their permissions can't be changed here.
errors.roleNotEligible: The platform administrator has not allowed this person's Job Title to hold this permission.
errors.unavailable: Permissions can't be verified right now. Nothing was changed — try again shortly.
errors.notDelegable: This permission can't be set per person for this company.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change this.
errors.notFound: This person was not found in your company.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Nothing was changed.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
errors.noJobTitle: This person has no Job Title, so nothing can be allowed for them.
